description: This PHP source file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'CompanyStructureDao' responsible for interacting with 'Subunit' entities within the organization's company structure hierarchy. It contains methods for CRUD operations, hierarchy management, and querying organizational units.

classes.name: CompanyStructureDao
classes.description: A data access object class for managing Subunit entities related to organizational structure, providing methods for CRUD operations, hierarchy updates, and queries.

methods.name: getSubunitById
methods.description: Retrieves a Subunit entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveSubunit
methods.description: Persists a Subunit entity to the database.

methods.name: addSubunit
methods.description: Adds a subunit to a parent subunit's hierarchy.

methods.name: deleteSubunit
methods.description: Deletes a specified subunit from the hierarchy.

methods.name: setOrganizationName
methods.description: Sets the organization name for the top-level subunit.

methods.name: getSubunitTree
methods.description: Fetches the hierarchical tree of subunits, optionally limited by depth.

methods.name: getMaxLevel
methods.description: Returns the maximum level/depth of the subunit hierarchy.
